features.description: Review the eight parked operator changes and reproduce concrete defects.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Review lists all eight commits and reproducible breaker and test-evidence probes.

features.description: Audit all forty features across the six August plans without silent closure.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Audit inventories all forty acceptance clauses, evidence references, current test results and explicit closure gaps.

features.description: Surface applicable skill dispositions through the public plan-review command.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Goal-only skill matching warns through cli.main, a valid disposition removes the warning, and plan files remain byte-identical.

features.description: Expose shipped adapter readiness probes through opt-in doctor execution.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Public doctor opt-in shows adapter probes; plain doctor does not run them; skip-auth does not invoke Firebase; warnings do not block core use; incompatible modes refuse.

features.description: Specify trustworthy command-execution evidence and upstream capture orchestration.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Design distinguishes claimed versus observed execution, defines explicit public entry points, bounded execution and capture-only provenance; records unresolved interface approval.

features.description: Reassess demand gates against known operator and community evidence.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Every active demand-gated body has an adopt, probe, or park disposition and a measurable activation trigger.

features.description: Design safe opt-in planner-driven revision of an existing plan.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Design includes typed output validation, preview/persistence, approval invalidation, history, recovery, cost bounds and public-entry acceptance tests.

features.description: Prove operator preferences do not grant worker dispatch authority.
steps: Inspect current producer and public consumer
features.acceptance: Dry-run and confirm paths refuse a preference-only operator as executor before supervisor dispatch.
